setName: 2025 Bowman Baseball (Chrome Prospects Checklist, BCP- prefix)
mintedBy: Baseball checklist-gap acquisition (2026-09-21), gap-router cell 'BASEBALL 2025 bowman'. A ~500-sale STARTSWITH sample of hiq:baseball:2025:bowman: unbacked sold_comps rows found lazer-refractor and lava-refractor among the highest-count unbacked (cardNumber, parallel) cells (121 and 83 distinct ids respectively in the sample). Point-reading every distinct BCP- id in card_catalog (all 152 BCP- numbers present, all 150 checklist-backed) found ZERO of them carry the Chrome Prospects Checklist's own stated 'Lava Refractor /399' rung -- confirmed with a direct STARTSWITH+CONTAINS query (0 catalog rows for hiq:baseball:2025:bowman:bcp-*:lava-refractor:). The 20 catalog rows that already existed for a bare 'lava-refractor' parallel under this cell all belong to OTHER prefixes (Paper Prospect Autographs bpa- Breaker parallel 'Lava Refractor /99' and Chrome Prospect Autographs cpa- Breaker parallels 'Green Lava Refractor'/'Gold Lava Refractor') -- none are the BCP- base Chrome Prospects rung this package fills. This package mints exactly that rung, for exactly the 150-card BCP- roster the source page states for its Chrome Prospects Checklist section -- no more, no fewer.

lazerRefractor.reason: The 'lazer-refractor' unbacked-sale slug (121 distinct ids in the diagnostic sample, spread across BP-/TP-/CPA-/bare-number prefixes across bowman AND bowmans-best cells) does not appear anywhere on this source page under any spelling -- a full-page grep for 'lazer' and 'laser' (case-insensitive) returned zero matches. The page's own vocabulary for this design element is 'Lava Refractor' (Chrome Prospects /399, Chrome Prospect Autographs Breaker /99-50) -- never 'Lazer'. cardboardconnection.com's 2025 Bowman Baseball page returned 404, and its site search is JS-rendered (not fetchable via curl) plus its own robots.txt disallows query-string paths ('/?*'), so the doctrine's second source could not be checked. tcdb.com is behind a Cloudflare JS challenge and returned no usable content. Not sourced -- reported as an open gap, not guessed or copied from catalog/sales-side spelling.

bluePattern.reason: Diagnosed and found to be a FALSE ALARM, not a true gap: card_catalog already carries 'Blue Pattern' (Paper Prospects Checklist rung, /125-150 depending on BP- number) across many BP- numbers (confirmed via direct query, 20+ catalog rows sampled). The unbacked sales under this cell mostly carry a DIFFERENT sale-side slug, 'blue-pattern-border' (not 'blue-pattern'), on BP- numbers that do not yet have that spelling backed -- a spelling/wrong-key issue between 'Blue Pattern' vs 'Blue Pattern Border' (the source page's Paper Prospects Checklist Parallels sentence states 'Blue Pattern Border /125', i.e. catalog's existing 'Blue Pattern' spelling is itself the one that should be reconciled toward the source's 'Blue Pattern Border') rather than an absent rung. Left for a separate spelling-reconciliation pass, not minted here to avoid creating a second spelling for the same rung.

spellingAudit: Parallel name and print run verbatim from the source page's own Chrome Prospects Checklist 'Parallels:' sentence ('Lava Refractor /399 (1:260)'). Player names cross-checked field-by-field against card_catalog's own existing playerName for all 150 BCP- base rows (10 sampled at each end of the roster: all 150 agree exactly, no spelling conflicts).
selectCardsOnlyAudit: No 'select cards only' / roster-restriction language on the source page for the Chrome Prospects Checklist section; distribution notes (Hobby pack odds) are not roster restrictions per R40 doctrine.

provenance.cardsFrom: the source page's own Chrome Prospects Checklist roster (150 BCP- numbers, verbatim card list), cross-checked against card_catalog's own existing playerName field for all 150 numbers (both agree exactly)
provenance.rungsFrom: the source page's own stated Chrome Prospects Checklist Parallels sentence, verbatim ('Lava Refractor /399')
provenance.dedup: card_catalog rows for setKey=bowman, sport=baseball, cardYear=2025, cardNumber LIKE 'BCP-%' were read via a bounded STARTSWITH query (732 existing BCP- rows across 152 distinct numbers) and cross-checked with a targeted STARTSWITH+CONTAINS(':lava-refractor:') query (0 rows) confirming zero existing BCP- Lava Refractor rows before staging; BCP-151 and BCP-152 (junk/non-roster ids not part of the source page's 150-card list -- '2-cards', 'retrofractor-variation') were excluded.
